text: Absolutely love this place when in Philly. Not only are the beer and appetizers great, the atmosphere, with all of it's history, is amazing. Definitely a great place to add to your list.

This is One of my favorite breakfast places in the city. Even with its location the menu doesn't give overly hipster vibes. The staff is friendly and always remember me which makes you feel appreciated as opposed to just a customer.

This place just doesnt get it. Pat's has died. Geno's had a nice long line and Pat's had no line yesterday at 6pm. We wanted to give Pat's another go to see if they pulled their heads out of their arses. Nope. They skimped out on the steak and hardly put any cheese on it. Next time we're going to John's Roast Pork or Tony Luke's.  RIP Pat's
Amazing food. I actually had a cheese hoagie and it was delicious. My partner had a cheesesteak and said it was the best he's ever had in his life!
Best cheesesteak in the city. No one else can compete with their rolls. Love this place and def worth the trip from Jersey.

Update to my earlier review:

I only made the initial review to warn others about the potential of not being reached out to and truly didn't think anyone would reach out to me. One of the dentists called me but I was in a meeting so I didn't answer and was reached out to via Yelp by a receptionist. In that initial message, they said they never got my online appointment request so I forwarded the confirmation to them saying it was sent. On the voicemail the dentist left, they said they have gotten 4 voicemails this year and mine was one of them... 4 voicemails and somehow I didn't get a call back? Upon review they said their web developer blocked certain email addresses so my message never made it to them or even went to their junk folder. In both the yelp message and voicemail they did apologize which was thoughtful but also felt like they were just trying to save themselves.

I did try to make an appointment but they were out of network for me so it did not happen. While I did appreciate their attempt to make things better, it just sounded like excuses to me about the situation so I'm only giving them 2 starts instead of making it 3 stars.
Ah, Good King, what a lovely place. My boyfriend and I are big fans of their steak frites and mussels (and Negronis). Come here and you won't be disappointed.

My friends and I were super excited to try this place -- and it didnt disappoint! They have everything from Pork to Buffalo Chicken (my fav) to Falafel bao buns. Definitely worth the price & will be back again!
We went here for my birthday lunch and couldn't have picked a better place. Atmosphere was amazing, service was great, and food was perfect. We will definitely be back!

To say I'm obsessed is an understatement! I live right around the corner and I could not be happier with my experiences here so far. The people who work there are so friendly, the coffee is fantastic, and the food is amazing. Even better- the prices are nothing outrageous. The ambiance is warm and welcoming with great soft folk music in the background. Definitely my new favorite coffee shop!!

There's not a lot of birria taco spots on the east coast in general so I was surprised how good the food was. We got the beef taco boxes and fiesta fries, and I would recommend both. The birria was thinner than what I was used to but the flavor in the tacos were still there. Everything came out very quickly. It's a small place with not that many tables but they have a huge bar area to sit at and some TV's to catch the game. The overall atmosphere of this place has a bar type feel, which is perfect if you're looking for a happy hour or a place with good eats and music. Between the music, art, food, & customer service I would deff recommend it.

This place is a Hidden gem for tourists. We have tried other places for cheese steak but Jim is number one. The only thing is make sure you bring cash. We drove around looking for atms and it was so worth it!
Nasty. gave me days old chicken.  Not good at all. Will nevee order from here again. Ordered lo mein and it was so dry it was inedible.
The issue has been rectified.  The customer service was really polite and mystery is solved
It was my first time visiting and I was very pleased! The nail tech was very skilled and tailored my manicure to my needs. I will Definately be back!

Drove from NY to see Emily King at Union Transfer. Came here based on the good reviews... Didn't disappoint. We would definitely come back. Ordered a wiz steak sandwich without. My husband ordered a provolone steak sandwich with.. We both enjoyed it!
Pay cash and it's slightly cheaper than if you use your card.

They were super careful about following covid precautions, all staff wearing masks and gloves, with sanitizer available. They only allow a limited number of people in to pick up their orders at one time. Their food is always delicious! It's my favorite place for pho

The restaurant stretched themselves outrageously thin by adding more outdoor tables than their kitchen or staff could manage. We had a reservation but were sat outside far from the restaurant at an uncomfortably small table the edge of a closed street with pedestrian traffic crossing right next to us. 15 minutes passed before we were greeted, an hour passed before one of our appetizers was provided. Another 30-45 minutes passed without the second appetizer or main courses so we asked our server what the status was and if it wasn't being prepared soon could we please pay for our appetizer and drinks and leave. The food came out about 5 minutes afterwards. The tofu scallop dish that took so long to come out was 3 bite-size pieces of unseasoned tofu that were slightly pan fried before being tossed on top of a bowl of bland tomato sauce. The chips were too burnt to eat. The rest of the food was okay, but overpriced for the quality/size/creativity ($9 for a few bites of fried potato balls). I do not blame our server as he was pleasant, but just faced with an unacceptably large section. Management needs to consider if maximizing the quantity of their sales is worth sacrificing the quality of their customers' experience. I'm truly disappointed as my partner and I were told that this was the best vegan restaurant in all of Philadelphia and expected it to be the highlight of our trip. We will not be returning or recommending this restaurant to friends.
Gel manicure completely lifted and peeled off within one day. Sloppy work. Don't waste your money here. Seriously overpriced. There are better salons in the area for less money.

The best Nashville hot chicken sandwich I've had outside of Nashville. I had it and tater tot's delivered and they were hot, perfectly cooked and very tasty. I've been looking for a place to have really good fried chicken products and now I've found it.

Amazing meal last night at aroma. I'd passed this restaurant a bunch of times on my commute but it wasn't until an act of kindness occurred between myself and the staff that I was lured in.
The food is really out of this world. Def my favorite place in Philadelphia for Italian. The flavors are unbelievable. 
And don't skip on dessert. I don't care how full I am, I am absolutely going to get their espresso chocolate pastry with ice cream. Idk what the actual name is but it is sooooo worth feeling uncomfortably full every time. :)

We stopped in for a cute dinner Saturday evening but we were al full from eating throughout the day we didn't end up ordering much for dinner. The fries and the cheese plate were very tasty. For dinner we shared a portobello mushroom steak, which was so delicious! It was cooked to perfection and had absorbed all of the yummy sauces and seasonings it was cooked with. Even though I did not take a photo of it, which I regret now, it was definitely one to remember.
I had the jerk chicken, yams, cabbage and macaroni and cheese. Everything was so good. I will visit again when I'm in the area.

Love this place!  Despite the name, I actually find their non-Pho options to be the best. (The pho is good though.) The pork chop and rice is honestly the best pork dish I've ever had. 

Everything is easily customizable so you can alter the dish to your preferences/allergies, and since you order through a touchscreen and they work from a printout, the workers never miss a detail no matter how many changes you make. 

It's a great value too. My family can get a delicious meal for three people for under $30 and have leftovers for the next day. Highly recommend.

My husband and I have heard so many good things about this restaurant and decided to give it a try.

We ordered a chicken Caesar wrap, and requested french fries on the side, a personal pizza, and 2 red velvet cakes.

We didn't end up getting any fries which we were disappointed about. As for the pizza, it was good, but we received it almost cold. As for the red velvet cake, we were satisfied with that!
Hella authentic trust me. Great value too. When they say it's so korean they're not kidding. Go shop next door at hmart and then come eat here aftetwards.

Completely satisfied with Mark & his team. I had a cracked pipe in my basement that could have turned into a huge problem so I contacted Mark for an estimate. He came out the next day and gave me a very fair price and even matched the price of another company who gave me a slightly cheaper quote. The work was completed within a week of receiving the estimate and looks great! I will definitely be contacting JB in the future for all of my plumbing needs!

I have been to Yards on a number of occasions particularly when I have visitors to the city. They have a large indoor seating area and a handful of tables outside now with COVID. I've had quite a few dishes here including the BBQ ribs, chicken cheesesteak, nachos, and pork sandwich. I probably have come back so many times because of how close it is, but the food is mediocre at best. I also find the beer to be pretty plain and unimaginative. While it is a nice location to visit (with ample parking), the food and drink make me think twice about coming back.

It was five years ago, a company that I worked for, ordered pizza from here. One of those was  Buffalo chicken, and it was deliciously topped with tender chicken, tasty, tangy, smooth Buffalo sauce, and Bleu cheese! The others were good but this one really left an impact but I never had it again, until this weekend...what a disappointment! I was in the area, and decided to order the Buffalo chicken as well as a half and half pizza, to satisfy the "good" pizza craving that I'd been having for this past year. The Buffalo chicken pizza did not have the same sauce, instead it was a hot sauce drizzle,  the chicken was dried out grilled chicken, and tasteless! The half and half was better but not by much, though it had black olives, green onions, sausage and pepperoni. The veggies were small enough to go on a doll house pizza! The bottom line is that I did not get the "good" pizza that I've been craving during this crazy pandemic, so the search continues!

Located on the 2nd floor of the Philadelphia Fashion District, Wonderspaces spans 24k sq ft and the art installations are spread out between two floors. My husband and I decided to come here because we both appreciate art and were interested based on all the promotional ads we saw. Yes, you can take Instagram worthy photos but I really liked that it was an interactive, immersive art experience that allowed you enjoy each installation at your own pace in a non intimidating space. You can go through each exhibit as quickly or as slowly as you want. It's just a good time. 

I think it's cool that they rotate the exhibits every couple months because then it makes the membership they offer potentially worth it especially because you get unlimited visits for the year along with other perks which include a 10% ticket discount for any friend you bring and a free drink for you and your friend at the bar (they do cap it at 6 complimentary drinks a year).

Would I go back? : I would definitely consider going back depending on how often the exhibits are changed. I also like how Wonderspaces showcases art in a way that is not too "Instagram-y" that it's gimmicky or too contemporary that it's pretentious; you can enjoy the exhibits regardless of whether or not you're into art.

I feel lucky to get my hair done by Eric at Bobby Mack. I've never been very comfortable in hair salons, not always knowing what to ask for or what to expect, but that changes the moment I step in the door here. I'm always met with hospitality and respect by the entire staff. 

Eric especially takes time to consult with me to give me a cut and color that makes me feel as amazing as it looks! He's helped me take my damaged hair and give it life, plus is informative and fun to talk to during the process. I would recommend this artist and salon in a heartbeat!

I had a craving for water ice and was walking around the Italian Market. My usual go to place is a bit out of the way and decided to give John's a try. Still not sure how to best describe water ice, but I was very happy with their portion sizes with the cup overflowing. Ordered a gelati which is ice cream and gelati which was a good snack on a warm day.
Went for the 2nd time to try their brunch and it was so AMAZING  Absolutely enjoy the food

Second time going , and I am certain this will be my Nail Palace because not only did "Lena" do exactly what I had asked ,and was very patient , But the service is soooo amazing, I felt like a princess .
They even give you a shoulder massage after your nails are done without even asking.
Happy to spend my money when I get good service.
So glad it's 3 blocks away .

Rocky is simply the best. His tree selection was massive, the environment with the Christmas music blasting was so fun and most importantly his customer service is unmatched. Thanks Rocky for helping us start a new Christmas tradition!

Love Trader Joe's, love the options. Enjoyed the fact that the aisles are actually big enough for two people with carts to walk down without hitting each other, unlike the other location. 

HOWEVER, they only validate during certain hours. For less than an hour of shopping, I had to pay $16 for parking. Won't be going back, especially since their validation hours are during busy shopping times.
Sam was our server and was very nice. The quality of food is great. Birthday treat was a nice surprise.

If I could give them 100 stars it still wouldn't be enough. We were greeted by our hostess who said our table would be ready in a few minutes. Our reservations weren't for another 45 minutes. I wanted to go a little earlier so we can hang out at the bar.  She said we could but to let her know when we were ready for our table. Had a drink at the bar and enjoyed the ambiance. Half hour were seated at our table on the second floor. The staff couldn't have been anymore accommodating. Definitely recommend.

The chicken banh mi is great. The price is cheap too. If you wanna try vietnamese authentic banh mi, this place is a must try. It's hard to find a parking and it's a take out restaurant. They also have Vietnamese coffee. Which is great.
Great atmosphere and good beer selection. Staff is friendly and the weather was amazing!

This place just shouldn't be open right now. They have no menu other than gross hotdogs and literally like 5 drink selections. You have to stand on the sidewalk to order, and they don't even have outdoor seating. It's just sad. At least the dude working was nice though.

First entered and a family of four was waiting for food.  Father was NOT wearing a mask and the cashier/manager did not ask him to put his mask back on or wait outside.  Cashier did NOT greet me.  Felt unsafe and left.  
Came back 4 minutes later, Cashier/Manager was not wearing his mask..when he did put it on he wore it incorrectly with an exposed nose.  
If these people can't enforce basic safety in a pandemic, how the hell do you trust them to follow basic rules of food safety?   
DO NOT PATRONIZE
Great service,very clean,they have take care about all the hygiene facility. The person i was communicating was very sweet and helping.Would love to use their services again! Highly recommended!

Beware during COVID Era - we ordered pick-up and the greeter at the door was not wearing a mask, not to mention was rude and would rather be on a cellphone than figure out which order was ours.

Looking to the back, the employees had masks on but were wearing them on their chins with their mouths and noses completely exposed. 

Ice cream was delicious though.

We were looking for a place to get Pho. Our regular spot didn't open until 4. So google.... and we came across this one which was a few blocks way from us. The service was great, the Pho was really good. Normally I get extra noodles at our other place. So I did the same here-did not need to do it-they give you more than enough. It's a nice size space, so we were socially distanced.  Definitely recommend.

The food here is amazing. Don't let the bad reviews change your mind about this place. Most bad reviews are about "mean" waiters and waitresses but at my experience there they were nothing but helpful. It was my first time doing KBBQ and hotpot and the lovely waitress taught us how to properly cook the food. The reason you're going to a restaurant is to eat good food. Even if the waiter might have had an off day that day please note that most of us aren't in a great mood anyways because of the pandemic but we still have to go to work and deal with people telling us what to do and that's the last thing we want to deal with. If the food is good just eat your food and leave. Amazing experience for me none the less
If you're looking for a reliable, tasty, burger or hoagie this is a good place to go to. I really like the chicken tender hoagie in particular

As a Dominican ... I was OVERJOYED when I found la Parada Maimon... I order delivery from here often. 

El pollo guisado (stewed chicken) is delicious. This has been my favorite meal my entire life and to find a place that makes it good enough to trick me into thinking I'm eating my grandma's cooking, is superbbbbb. 

The sweet plantains, skirt steak, bistec encebollado (steak w onions), empanadas (pattys), tres leches are great. 

You get sooo much food for such a good price. I live in Univ City and I'm surprised they deliver this far... the food makes it here in great shape and I'm always a very happy customer

If I'm anywhere near Philly, and I need a cheesesteak, Dalessandro's is the #1 destination stop. Every steak is good here. Some might consider this sacrilegious, but I'm partial to the pizza steak, because it's baked, and so all that hot, good greasiness just binds together in a beautiful one-of-a-kind sandwich experience. Dalessandro's steaks are the closest thing I've found to the long, long departed Sophie's Steaks in west Philly.

We placed an order online at 10:15 on Saturday and did not receive it until 11:50. We waited 1:45min for a bit of ice cream! What was the worst part? When we placed the order online, it said the wait would be 20min. If we knew it was going to 1:45 we would never have placed the order; and since we pre-paid online (you have to for COVID reason) there wasn't even a way to cancel it.

It seems like other reviewers has a similar experience, so this is clearly not a one-time thing. It's a fundamental flaw in their business model that's been going on all year. I will not be back here

The ice cream itself  was ok, but definitely not worth the wait

Received a $50 bill for an appointment I cancelled. CANCELLED well before the date. I had to call about 4 times, since no one ever answers the phones, but I spoke to the woman at the front desk (the rude one- you all know who I am talking about) and CANCELLED IT!!!!
The food was delicious. server was super polite and sweet. Great atmosphere. The parking outside was also very convenient

My car was hit in the side in a hit and run (I have a little Mazda 2 and it was an SUV) and decided to have insurance help me find a collision place. I'm so happy I went with Caliber! My car needed a new fender, new passenger door, back door fixed, strut replaced, and alignment. They kept in touch during the whole process, finished when they said they would and made sure I was seamlessly in and out of a rental. I definitely recommend them- though I hope I never need them again, I would definitely go to them if I have to!

NOTE - Noise Pollution is BACK OPEN THROUGH AUGUST. The family is keeping the store open to liquidate the remaining inventory before shutting down for good. Please help support Jack's amazing family during such a tragic time for them.

Ordered on a Saturday night for a large family meal and everything was excellent! Will definitely return soon. We ordered the salt roasted cauliflower, swordfish pastrami and rye, big a** salad, roasted chicken, smoked octopus, whole trout, corn donuts, chocolate blood pudding, the basque style cheesecake. To drink we had the milk punch, the e&a black Manhattan, and the Rusty Rail IPA. Cauliflower was a great option for the vegan in our family.  As a meat eater I still enjoyed this.  Swordfish pastrami and rye was an adventure on my tastebuds. Probably one of the groups favorites.  Big a** salad was a meal in itself... guess that's where it gets it's name from.  The roasted chicken was amazing.  Moist chicken with a great smoked taste.  The greens with the chicken were excellent and rich in flavor. The smoked octopus is by far the best octopus I've ever had.  I would put it up against any octopus around!!  Trout was fresh and presented well.  Corn donuts had a great spice to them and were great for the group.  Both deserts were delicious.  Blood pudding was definitely a new try for us and we all loved it!   Cheesecake was great also.  All the adult drinks were excellent and were great to go!  We will DEFINITELY be back soon for this adventure!

This experience was the worst ever!!! Each visit to philly i go to max's for pepper cheesesteak hoagies. Always fantabulous. The last 2 visits including today was nothing short than horrible!! Ordered 6 pepper cheesesteaks w/salt, pepper, grilled onions & sweet peppers; 2 same way no cheese and 1 whole w/ salt, pepper grilled onions and ketchup.see order below:

Pd $60 for an uber to p/u hoagies.. Upon p/u i checked hoagies and none had extra meat. Went back in to advise what i discovered and the older grill person (a man) became belligerent arguing that he put xtra meat on 3. See below i requested all to have xtra meat!!! Another gentleman interjected and told me to bring the hoagies back and apologized after speaking with the rude grill cook. I then thanked the gentleman and added an additional $5 tip to the already $20 tip on my card. I get back to my daughters' home and opened my hoagies only to discover xtra meat very little onion,absolutely no peppers and definitely no flavor which means no oil or salt and pepper!!

Needless to say i will not be returning to max's when i return to philly next month.!! I try to patronize our community businesses whether at home or abroad, but it saddens me to say i will not continue to support a business that does not value my money nor my continuous promotion of max's to all of my family, friends and constituents that frequently visit the philly area.

After talking to my uber driver after the major blunder she recommended dalessandro's steaks on wendover street, therefore that is where my next search for philly's finest steak hoagie will be.

Kim T at Volume has been my stylist and friend for almost 12 years. I followed her when she moved locations twice (the first the whole salon moved). I swear she is a genius with hair color. She is part artist and part chemist. I have been so many different shades of red, I don't think either of us can keep track anymore. It's always beautiful. Kim constantly is studying and taking classes to hone her technique and it shows. She is wildly talented and I am constantly complimented on my color. Her cuts are obviously fantastic too!  

I have had cancer for about 8.5 years and while I never fully lost my hair, at times it was really thin. Kim has always made me feel good about myself at my worst. I can't tell you how many times I have walked in and said "Kim, I'm a mess. Please fix me." and I leave feeling like a new person. She has always been warm, funny, and empathetic and is truly one of my favorite people. 

Volume is a great salon and a nice fit for Kim. The whole staff is so nice, talented, and unpretentious. I really respect and appreciate how careful they have been during COVID too. 

I included a few shades of hair color Kim has done for me over the years. Some are natural and some are funky, but they are all beautiful. If you are considering booking with Kim, do it! She will make you feel as gorgeous as you already are!
Delicious cheesesteaks although not my absolute fave. Very crowded spot. Mainly a take out spot due to right quarters. Be prepared to wait in line if you come at a busy time.

One of the best meals I've had in Philly! They currently have a prix fixe menu which is well worth the price. We got the Lamb Tzimmes and short ribs, along with matzo soup and chicken liver mousse as appetizers. Our waitress also threw in a full order of complimentary latke fries. Between all this food and the challah rolls, I was beyond stuffed by the end of the meal. The short ribs were a good portion size and came with bread, pickles, and sauces for constructing into a sandwich. The lamb was in the form of a thick stew and the prunes added a really nice flavor.

Overall, very impressed. Good food, good service, and nice, strong heat lamps for outdoor dining!

Just like the one's in New York City. I have eaten at the one at Brookfield Place in the financial center many times. This Dig is the same menu and the same high quality. It was packed during lunch. Not surprising as the Brookfield Place Dig is always busy too. This is the best bowl meal in Center City. I'm happy they opened in Philadelphia.

Good customer service! Nice place 
Coffee: Rwanda pour over very GOOD 
Espresso: Brazil super smooth
Latte: Gingerbread latte delicious 

A+

Had an excellent evening at Barra Rossa. We participated in their 6 course Halloween themed dinner. Courses were timed perfectly with a drink accompanying each round. All of the staff were friendly and attentive. The food was absolutely decadent. I highly recommend you dine here if you have the chance!

I've been to this place probably 5x times 
Absolutely love their food. Its always fresh, quick and delicious. Service is very nice too! We really enjoy it
Highly recommended

I ordered from Uber eats and specifically said in the comments if your Shrimp Fried Rice has egg; NO EGG due to an allergy. I received my order and the fried rice had egg. I called the establishment directly and with a lack of customer service I was told to 
come in the store. If it was that simple I wouldn't have ordered from Uber Eats; I live in another section of the city and was curious about this establishment. I was then told by the establishment that made the error to contact Uber Eats. Not sure how contacting the third party online was going to satisfy my hunger, but it was obvious they could care less about a dissatisfied new customer. I contacted Uber Eats online and gave the food I couldn't eat to someone else. I have also deleted this establishment from my bookmarks and not inclined to visit in person. Very negative first impression based on the response to their error. 
DISSATISFIED!!

The office was very clean and efficient. I did not have to wait too long after my scheduled appointment time.  Everyone was nice, addressed my concerns and offered options. I really loved Dr Meltzer, demeanor and patient approach. I have already recommended him to several coworkers

What is going on here? There is some kind of disconnect between the online ordering system and the restaurant itself. When I ordered, I got a message that my food would be ready at 6pm. It's now 6:30, and I'm still waiting for my food, along with 15 other frustrated patrons. A woman just asked when her order would be ready and they said "We don't know." This is ridiculous.

We made mobile orders at this shake shack. They were always ready by the time stated it will be ready on the app. The employees were courteous and quick. The food was still hot. However the second time which was the next day, it was past rush-hour and the food got a bit cold. The mushroom burger wasn't as good since the cheese kinda solidified and wasn't melted like the first time I ordered there. I would still go back for another burger.

This was the first Christmas Eve I got scungilli salad and calamari salad from Anastasia's.  Wow, what a disappointment.  First, they charged me a 2.5% upcharge for using a credit card (which they failed to tell me when I called for information).  When I opened the scungilli salad I was hit with an odor of raw onions.  Now, I have never seen raw onions in a scungilli salad  ($35/lb) and this one was FULL of onions.  Then I opened the calamari salad ($25/lb) .  They had 6 mini tomatoes in the small 1lb container which was just put in to give you less seafood.  
I usually buy my salads at DiBruno's, which by the way have mini shrimp and mussels in them.  I'm so sorry I didn't.   DiBruno's definitely worth the wait in line and I found out later....they were cheaper.

I had never been here and have lived in the neighborhood for a while, so I finally tried it out this week. The seating set up is great. Indoor seating is distanced throughout the restaurant and then outdoor seating was distanced with some covered and other seats uncovered. The drink menu was good with lots of options and they also serve food till 8:30-8:45. They had lots of options and a touch-less ordering system. We got a pizza and it was fine. It's a cute place and I think I'll return but next time just for the atmosphere, great service and drinks.
Had their seasonal peppermint mocha and it was delicious! Very inviting interior, can't wait to be able to sit inside.

Went to pick someone up at the airport. It is clear that only morons  could have designed the way ALL the cars have to pass ALL the passenger pickup areas at ALL the terminals and wait for ALL the people. It took more time to get out of airport as it took to reach the passenger. Must have been designed for traffic volume in the '50s. The cell phone lot was full on a Sat afternoon.

I can't believe my last review was 2015, back when they only made 40 pies a day.. now there's a newly transformed space that is covid-friendly for the times (pexi glass between tables, spaced and follow social distancing, masks on all staff, and contactless ordering system via QR code)

For a party of 4 that ordered 2 pies, tomato pie, roasted veggies, 2 desserts and 2 rounds of alcohol our bill including tip came to about $190. 

Our friends ordered the pie and added anchovies, they loved their pie. We ordered the roasted potato pie and it was delicious. The olives were nice and salty and added a lot of flavor and texture to the pie, great crust too. We enjoyed everything we ordered, including the soft serve ice cream and service was great. 

Overall, I would recommend Beddia, it's worth a visit but personally for me it's a once in a while rotation as the prices are a bit steeper than the many great pizza establishments that Philly has to offer. But it's a great treat and place to bring guests!

El Vez is absolutely incredible if you're able to find seating, it's always so packed and they do not take reservations over the phone. It's a good thing they are packed, it means people keep coming back because it really is that awesome and is worth the 45-60 minute wait because the food and drinks are amazing. 

Speaking of drinks, the last time I was there with my coworkers we all got a pitcher of sangria with fresh fruit, it was great, but if you're looking to get a buzz I wouldn't recommend because it's barely alcoholic; still great nonetheless. 

I also ordered a Limeade and oh my god when I tell you that it's my favorite all time non-alcoholic beverage from any restaurant I've ever had.... I'm serious. It's divine. 

We ordered chips and dip for the table, I absolutely love their red dipping sauce. We also ordered the Crab guacamole and that was heavenly as well. I ordered shrimp tacos as well as the mexican corn. I wasn't a big fan of the tacos but the corn totally made up for it, it was beyond fantastic, everyone at the table who also ordered the corn totally raved about it as well, that's unbelievable. 

Definitely check this place out! I highly recommend, just make sure you walk in and put your name in and go grab a drink around the corner or something to wait for your table :)

My dad talked to my mom in Spanish at this location and the worker told him "Speak English!" It was his turn to make his sub and he asked for lettuce and tomato and the worker said "that's not an option" he said he would pay extra if he needed to. The worker throughout the entire process was giving my dad retorts. At the end the worker refused to give him any sauces. Again, he said he paid extra if necessary. The worker then said "pinche viejo" which translates to f**ing old man. My mom said she would report them to subway HQ. The workers ran in the back but she managed to take a picture of one of them.

We used the lot for a week.  The price was very reasonable. I didn't realize when I left that I had left my drivers window all the way down.  
When we arrived back from our trip there was a black garbage bag taped over my window.  
They made sure my vehicle was secure.  
Highly recommend this facility.

I really wanted to like this place for their soup dumplings but my most recent visit really disappointed me. I've been to Dim Sum Garden before in 2019 during a trip to Philly and remember really loving the food (pork soup dumplings, mapo tofu), and decided to come back. 
We ordered pork soup dumplings, beef ho fun, mapo tofu and shanghai dumplings. Some of the soup dumplings came out already broken, but the ones that were intact were still good. The ho fun was standard, but could've been more flavored. The shanghai dumplings were good. The mapo tofu, on the other hand, was a complete disaster. The tofu was uncooked and cold on the inside. The sauce itself was orange, rather than the usual deep red color, AND it was gelatinous rather than liquidy. I tried one tofu and it was still raw on the inside. We did not even make any dents in the dish. When I had alerted staff about this, they tried to tell me the plate was hot. However it was the food itself that was cold, indicating that the dish was inadequately reheated. They took the meal back and offered another dish however there was nothing that was really appealing and by that point I didn't want to risk another dish coming out in the same condition. The waitress said she couldn't take it off the check because it would come out her pay and her boss did not allow it. When asked to talk to the boss, she said the boss was not in. When asked to talk to the manager, the waitress had called another woman over who said the manager was not in either... at that point, I had no energy to continue going back and forth over a clear health code violation.
Their COVID precautions were also questionable. There was no social distancing, no temperature checks, and capacity was not limited. Water cups had lots of cracks in them and had a very distinct, unpleasant smell.
great service, shaquan helped me and was friendly and quick, got me all set for a long trip. thank you!

I came here for a second time and all I can say is WOW  
I love their food here so f-delicious. I would come back again and again because the flavor is excellent and the portion of food they give is enough for 2 people. I was not disappointed this visit at all the chicken was juicy and tender and the yams and rice with peas were out of this world.
Amazing! Absolutely delish sushi pizza and dragonfruit lemonade! Sushi pizza is enough to make a meal out of!

I chose this place because of all the good reviews they had. I really should have read the bad reviews because they have been the most consistent with my experience. Communication is absolutely a problem with this place. 

I am still waiting to hear back from ANYONE about the dress that I PAID FOR IN FULL and should have ARRIVED 01/30/2020. This is not the experience I wanted to have for my wedding, especially what I'm suppose to wear on that day. I am at a loss for words and just heartbroken.

I dont know if it's a Philly thing but I was definitely made to feel uncomfortable while walking in this store. I cant even say it's a race thing because the guy who followed me around trying not to look obvious was black. It's a shame because I have money to spend I literally came in with multiple bags from shopping and I had on a Mackage coat ($1200) with the matching mask & balenciaga's. So there was absolutely no need to follow me around but eff em. I'll spend my money elsewhere. After I peeped him in the mirror behind me I put all that sh*t down & walked out! Im from NY & I have NEVER experienced that in my life!

We stopped in for dinner and I had the beet salad. I could eat this everyday! Toasted pistachios, ricotta, beets...what could be any better? My husband had a pizza that had just the right amount of spice.  Their sangria was also very good. Nice job!

The food is always amazing !!!!! The only issue with yesterday's order, it was less meat than usual. Before the quarantine and shut down, you were able to watch your food being made so you could request extra. Now with curbside service, it's already made when you pull up.

This place was so fun we did it twice in one. On a trip from Dallas with some time kill so my teen daughter and some friends said they wanted to do an escape room. We've done many, all of the country and this one did not disappoint. They liked it so much they booked another one here a few hours later.

A new Philly favorite! I came for restaurant week and got the snails as an appetizer, trout as the main meal, and creme brûlée for dessert. Everything was A+ particularly the trout. The restaurant is quiet and spacious, with the tables well spaced out. Location wise, it's far enough off of South Street for it to be quiet and removed from the usual South Street shenanigans.

Great food from a low key and unpretentious restaurant.

Excellent and efficient service. Arrived on time. Completed removal of a very large tree in record time. Cleaned up and left everything in tact. Would definitely recommend if you want reliable and quality work.

BEWARE

Keep it moving Llc are liars and thieves. If there was such thing as a zero or negative star rating that's what they'd get. I list here in my review on Facebook our timeline of dealing with them in hopes you will find someone else. God is good and justice will be served to everyone employed by this company.

I'm now one month and one week without HALF my things on an exclusive contract that I signed to have my things here within 5-7 business days buy 7/2. 
I haven't heard from anyone since. They don't answer my calls. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT SIGN WITH THIS COMPANY. 

Liars and thieves. 

IF YOU WANT TO BE LIED TO, BAITED AND SWITCHED THE ENTIRE LENGTH OF YOUR MOVE, hire them.

Tony was great to work with. He was very responsive from the beginning, and upfront about everything. He replaced 3 toilets, and fixed a few other issues that we were having. I highly recommend choosing Graciano Sewer and Drain for your next project or issue.

Found this off of Uber Eats and I was skeptical but I'm glad I gave it a try. The food was delicious. I got the chicken shawarma plate and the beef shawarma plate and both were excellent. However, I do believe the beef contained lamb also... 

The food tasted fresh and I really enjoyed the hummus. The rice was so flavorful I could've eaten it all by itself. Overall recommend if you are in the area!
A wonderful surprise in the midst of the Callowhill / Chinatown neighborhood. Excellent food, service and comfortable place to hang out for cocktails. Love it!!!

Honestly the best Moroccan food I've had in my life. Great service, especially by Mr. Samir that made our visit memorable. Will definitely visit again. 
P.s: it's cash only.

Wow I'm not sure why it took me so long to get here, but I can assure you that it won't be too long until I return. I've been too distracted by nam phuong and le viet and that Asian grocery store to pop in here. It's byo and can accommodate a decent crowd. We had a large group they sat in the back. We came early though; I'm sure it would be really difficult to have a large party later in the evening. 

We started with skewers, which were amazing and the gado-gado, which is this tofu dish with other veggies in a peanut sauce and edible shell. So worth it, even though it looks slightly unappetizing. We then ordered by number, and all our dishes came out at the same time. I got the seafood fried rice, which had slices of fish cake in it. I didn't expect to eat the whole thing, but I couldn't help myself. Can't wait to go back ASAP!

Regrettably, I placed an order at cleavers in CC Philadelphia for lunch today. Apparently, they decided it would be best to serve a raw, breaded piece of chicken cutlet instead of a cooked chicken tender. There was 8 of us who ate together today and 3 other customers found similar results when biting into their chicken tender. 100% will have food poisoning from eating here. GETS BETTER, Cleavers does not provide refunds for meals presented like this. Would never ever recommend a facility that operates like this.

Not it for me. It was highly overpriced for a small amount of food. I think people mostly go for the name. I would prefer a larger portion at a smaller price. I am really sick of these fancy named restaurants getting away with subpar food and overpriced menus.

I ordered something online from these guys, and they provided a tracking number but never shipped the item after 6 days.  Finally provided a refund when I asked the 2nd time.  Lots of other shops out there that will provide better service, avoid this one.

Had a long flight over from Dublin. Googled restaurants at PHL and Chickie's & Pete's came up.  Sat down at a table with NO "out of service" sign.  Waitress with a black pony came by to ask if I was waiting on "take out" since the section was closed.  I let her know I sat down since there wasn't a sign.  She grabbed the sign off a nearby table and slammed it on my table and said "here you go" and walked off.  Didn't bother to direct me to an open section etc.  I asked for the manger. He advised she should have served me.  He offered an open section and thanked me for the feedback.  I declined.

If I can rate this a 0 star I would. I am not the one to normally complain but this has to be one of the worse experiences ever. Absolutely disgusting!!!! Selling old, spoiled, molded desserts. If you ever decide to buy from them, please do yourself a favor and ask them how long was the pastries and desserts left out for. Also, ask them how fresh was everything made. I highly advise for you all to inspect your food especially, their pre-packaged desserts and everything else before buying or eating. I bought a coconut banana dessert that was completely covered in white, furry mold!!  Didn't noticed it until I got home.The entire package was all molded and the coconut sauce was completely rotten and reeked. This will definitely be my last time here. Best of luck

WORST BRUNCH EVER! Visited this place for an event during brunch and the food and most of the waitstaff were a disaster. They were pushing and cursing at the party goers. Although the event was probably at the building capacity limit the staff wasn't able to handle the sheer volume for a private event. 

The food was disgusting, ordered the avocado toast which came with a salad and an unknown white spread. After trying it the avocado toast couldn't have been real and that mystery white spread was as actually fish (surprise!). I returned it after two bites and was never refunded although I was told I was. We FINALLY got a decent server but he came so close to the end of the service we weren't sure he would get the tip. Overall WORST food ever!

This is our go-to Asian take out place. The food is always consistently good. Yes, they have the usual Chinese restaurant staples but they also have really good sushi. The Gyoza dumplings are awesome, my favorite dish in the place. We have been going here for many years and have never been disappointed. Plus, the owner Tina and her family are friendly and you always get really good service. Can't say enough good things about this place

Great ambiance snd menu. Will definitely come back

On arrival you can park on the street but half s block down there is a parking lot that you can pay $5 for 3 hours (as of 2021). Totally worth it to not stress about your car.

Restaurant has a relaxed and hip decor. Has some seats on sidewalk. We sat out back. It was a large are under a tent. Really quite lush. I was totally surprised!! We had advanced reservations on a Friday for lunch and it was busy but seats still available.

When sat we were told they automatically add 20% tip and there is a 90 minute max. Since it wasn't busy at 2pm and we were drinking steadily they didn't seem to care about the max time. If it was busy I'm sure they would do they could seat more guests.

Menu has lots of great healthy options and plenty that aren't. Breakfast served until 3 pm too! I had the berry salad with chicken and shared chicken strips with my friends. Another friend had a burger that she devoured. The other person had a salad, Caesar with a poached egg. She finished her plate.

The chicken strips were definitely shareable. Probably 5 -6 giant strips. Came with 3 delicious dipping sauces. I loved the mustard. My salad was huge!! I couldn't finish it. The protein cooked well. One note that it was really covered in dressing. Perhaps ask for it on the side and add it yourself. 

Beverage list was good too!

My second time here was not pleasant.. he never smoothed my nails out so my nail polish was super bubbly and he cut my finger and didn't say sorry.. overall experience with this nail tech was super rushed. i accepted the job he did and paid because that's just who i am as a human lol. i had to go to Harmony nails right after because i was so unhappy with the work.. probably will never come back here to risk having this experience again. Update: acrylics have already began lifting after only 9 days.

I really want to like this place. The ambience is great and it's a really nice place to luxuriate and have a long drawn out family style meal. 
I have no problems with the service. The servers work hard here. The cheese plate appetizer was very good. The bread is extraordinary. 
The problem is I've been here twice and never plan on ordering a $42. (halibut) fish entree ever again. 
It was the worse meal I ever had. Whatever glaze they used on the fish tasted foul. Nothing anyone should put any where near their mouth. 
If you have any sensitivity to salt, stay away from the fish. 
The 1st time I was here I ordered bass but received the swordfish. I was so hungry I ate some but again, so salty I could not finish.
I also tasted the pasta which was al dente. 
No problems with the pasta. 
Please Cicala, get the fish right. There's no need to over season fish which is a salty item.
Olive oil, pepper, lemon is all you need to season fish!!

Stopped by last Tuesday to print. Staff there went out of their way to direct me. It was very easy. They are enforcing masks and physical distancing. Shout out to the assistant manager (or manager,  don't remember her full title) and the other staff members for finding my wallet and returning it to me. I felt safe and taken care of.

Erica, the "manager", is rude and unprofessional.  Please find a new job. You are clearly not in the profession you should be in. Drive thru service is slow. Food tastes stale and looks thrown together. Most of the staff is friendly, but Erica...whew.
Not the greatest cheesesteak I've had in Philly. It's not bad, but I prefer the chopped steak style. Plus, it's a bit light on the meat and there is not much flavor.

Do yourself a favor and shop online!! The people that work at this gap are not only rude but also incompetent...the man at the register couldn't figure out the register and was basically yelling at me to take my return out of the bag and "hold on!" While he figured out how to do his job...all while his manager  stood next to him and  looked on like there was no issue..that's what I call customer service

My three friends and I had our first dinner together since three opening of outside dining. Olivia was our server who was phenomenal. We had the ricotta over a focaccia bread, the meatballs, pepperoni pizza, and sausage pizza. Our food was simply amazing every last bite of it. It's first come first serve get yourself over there!

the vietnamese shaking beef short rib taco and caramelized garlic pork taco were the second best tacos i've ever had (second only to birria tacos). the organic crunchy tofu taco was also really good - a bit lacking in flavor and sauces but a great vegatarian option. this is now on top of my list of places to come back to in philly! 100000000/10 

viet shaking beef short rib: 11/10
caramelized garlic pork: 11/10
organic crunchy tofu taco: 9/10
fish n chips: 8/10 the fish and waffle fries were insanely crispy but i wish the fish was a bit more tender n soft on the inside (it was kinda dry) 

food insta: @strwbrrryboba for more food recs :)

This place is amazing the food is delicious!!! I love the feeling of an original Italian kitchen this place gives me! I can't wait to go back the lasagna is amazing everything is SO FRESH!!! and u won't regret it here for yummy Italian cravings this is the PLACE!! If you don't want to sit and eat and your in a rush to go home you can grab a to go dish, Which was also amazing ... safe to say I'm addicted!!

Our experience with Ilyse and the team at Allure was great, start to finish. Everyone is super professional and knowledgeable. Our consultation with Ilyse was so helpful - she really helped us understand what we needed and showed us options that made us feel confident in our choices. Installation was so quick and now we have beautiful window treatments! I'd recommend them to everyone and I know we'll use their services again in the future :)
My German shepherd always comes back fluffed out, smelling great, clean and I'm always satisfied. Have been going the last 1.5 yr. Recommend Forsure

11/21/21 WOW WOW WOW!!! 

I can't say enough wonderful things about the Knowlton Mansion. It is so exquisite and just pure class all the way.

We celebrated our daughters first year anniversary rather than the traditional reception. Like so many weddings, our celebration was delayed a year.

The tasting at Knowlton mansion was a perfect way to get excited about the wedding. I truly enjoyed sampling all the appetizers and entree choices. The cake and fillings were all amazing.

My daughter, the bride, was well taken care of by the Bridal assistant, Danny.  Danny offered champagne to us upon arrival.  She was sweet and kind and helped us bustle my daughters dress which was no easy task! 

Not only did we enjoy the ballroom, but the bride gets full access to the upstairs rooms for changing, hair, makeup etc. there was an incredible stone wine cellar we took advantage of too. Let's not forget the outside tent and fire pit.

The servers and bartenders were very attentive as was Chris, our wedding coordinator for the day. The service was friendly and kind. 

All the food was such a treat. Artfully prepared and crafted special occasion food! You know you're at a special affair when you are served amazing creations.  

This is a beautiful venue. I highly recommend considering Conroy Catering and The Knowlton Mansion.

Impressive, memorable, and forever memories.
Best donuts I've ever eaten! I eat there every time I go in Reading Terminal!

I love the tabuli salad. And those cheese pies are probably going to kill me but they are like a mozzarella stick made love to a cheese dumpling and I love them. Especially dipped in that garlic aoli. 
The chicken is usually cooked just fine but can be a little fatty or tough. 
The hummus is good but could use more olive oil.

I am new to the city and was searching for Filipino food. The area is diverse but hardly have Filipino restaurants in the city. I stumbled upon this place on Yelp. 

I ordered for pick up. I got the longanisa ( filipino sausage) rice plate, Karioka ( sweet rice balls with syrup) and sisig ( sizzling pork belly). 

The price ranges from $10-15 without tax and portions are pretty good. Their location is a hole on the wall, which makes it even better for homemade and authentic Filipino Food!

One of my fave filipino food is longanisa and this place made it super homemade. The flavor is sweet, salty, and fresh. They serve it with pickled veggies on the side, garlic rice with fried egg on top and sliced tomatoes and cucumbers. Highly recommend this! 

If you love unique desserts, try the Karioka! Its a sweet glutinous rice with coconut - lol so good. 

Who does not love PORK BELLY? I do! Their sisig pork belly is so good. Its crispy pork belly with this whole secret sauce. I dont know what it was but I ate the entire plate- rice plate with fried egg on top (optional) but SUPER recommended that you eat with fried egg, garlic rice and sliced veggies!

When I picked up my order, there were people dining in- def following the guidelines.  Their interior is very cute. The owner, Cesar and staff were very friendly and super kind. It is a family owned business. 

I highly recommend this place for a unique, homemade and authentic food. 

FYI, they have vegetarian and vegan dishes too. For the sisig pork belly, they can make it with Tofu. I am gonna try it next time. 

Their menu is simple and small. The flavors are there. I AM COMING BACK!

I went back and had a fabulous dinner on date night. I definitely would say if you are going on a Friday or Saturday make a reservation. There was a bit of a wait. Also it is kind of loud during dinner so be prepared to raise your voice a little. Our food was just as wonderful as the first time I went. I fell in love with the verde salsa. If you like cilantro this is for you. Can't wait to stop by again.

I contacted Michele only a month before my wedding since the plan was changed bc of covid and she was absolutely wonderful! She would always respond to emails quickly and I did not stress at all on that part of my wedding planning. On the wedding day she arrived right on time with her assistant Kat and they not only did an amazing job but also kept us entertained with fun conversation throughout the process. Would definitely recommend her for your upcoming events!

Outdoor seating and distanced! Menus are electronic and servers are appropriately masked! 

Came here instead of Assembly one evening and we were soooooo happy we did! There's nearby parking with the Meter Up App. 

Ambiance is so nice, it's adjacent the BFP, so there were a few loud motorcycles going by and we needed to pause our conversations. Our server was Sarah, and she was extremely knowledgeable! 

We ordered the Oregon Pinot Noir- HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! It was simply delicious. 

The complimentary corn bread was superb with that salty butter. The shrimp cocktail was flavorful and fresh! The shrimp were large! And the cheese board was awesome. The salt chips were a great savory addition to the honey and nuts. I don't like blue cheese but I loved the other two. 

We had a great time! Will certainly revisit!

Umm i waiting ina drive thru for about 25mins i paid for a hot chocolate then i gets to the window they say the machine down ! instead of saying that before i paid then my boyfriend says sprite with no ice they gives him
sprite with ice then we asked for our money back for the hot chocolate because they told us they had no cookies to replace it so then when we asked for our money back they say wait two mins for cookies we had to pull over wait about 5mins finally gets my cookies then our fries are all over the bag just fucking terrible

This place is a deli staple in Rittenhouse. From their breakfast sandwiches to their lunch sandwiches, you can not go wrong with anything you order from here. The inside is very cute and retro, it's a great spot to meet up with a friend for lunch or just to enjoy lunch alone.
Over a month since my review and the owner is still harassing me. Some screen shots of his many responses below.
My favorite spot in the entire city!!! Their food is delicious, authentic and very fairly priced. I also love the view and vibe of the rooftop bar, their cocktails are legit!

I loved this place. Came here with my friend for her birthday and had such a good time! The service could have been a bit better, but wasn't bad overall. The drinks were immaculate and the food so good! Views? Spectacular. So pretty. What more do you need?

Shaun Griffith is a fantastic accountant. He has helped me set up numerous business entities. He has completed my personal and business tax returns for the last several years. I am always impressed every year about how quick, easy and accurate it is. If you need a great accountant for any business accounting, tax returns or financial advice..Shaun is the best option. Period. He knows the IRS regulations and state guidelines inside and out! He is a 16 out of 10 !

Excellent selection at this little plant shop. Though small in size, the diverse plant options and fair price points make this place a true gem of Northern Liberties. I purchased a Swiss cheese plant that I had been searching for forever. They even gave me a little plant care instruction card. STUMP truly cares about their products and their customers. Definitely coming back!

This is a great place after a nice meal in Chinatown Philadelphia! The place looks very nice with crystal chandeliers and a very nice and relaxing atmosphere. They have lots of different teas, coffees and snacks. They were very attentive and offer high class cups and saucers! The coffee and teas were very tasty and the service was excellent! Their desserts are very flavorful. I ordered the custard which was excellent!  You can get their drinks with sweetness or plain. Once you arrive they take your temperature because of covid. They seat you down and you are given a QR code to order from their menu on your phones. Everyone can order on their phones and the table gets one bill. Lots of fun and highly recommend this place. They also have other locations in NYC. They have been opened as of October 18, 2020 for about a year. Will definitely go back again.

Really good bahn mi sandwiches in Chinatown!

Very small shop in Chinatown with only 1 table inside. Limited menu, which I love because that means they perfect the food. Ordered the QT special and it had so much flavor. So generous with all of the meat and veggie filling. I loved the baguette, it had the most perfect crunch.

If you use credit cards they charge a 5% fee. Apparently they have Venmo, but didn't let me know until after I paid. 

Friendly service and I will be back. Highly recommend checking out this Vietnamese style hoagie!
Best Korean food in center city hands down, especially the fried chicken it's sooo delicious!

Women - stay away. 

I called to see if they could take me in for an inspection. He was nice and took me in the same day. After I got there, I also asked for an oil change and told him I was not in a rush. 

$120 for an oil change. I've never seen anything like that in my life. If there are add ons, you'd think they'd call to let me know. I've lived in a LOT of cities and have never heard of anything like this. 

They're also apparently open at 8am. I get there at 8:30 and people are waiting outside cause no ones opened the doors. The mechanics are also just hanging around waiting. 

The best part is the man who worked the counter started asking about my personal life. I asked to come pick up my car at a different time, and he said no and asked me to come later because he wanted to see me. Will never be coming back.

As far as apartments go in Philly, it's a decent apartment complex.  It's in a nice location next to Fairmont Park with plenty of trails to run, hike, bike or walk.  The parking is decent as well, a large outdoor lot with garage parking as well. The management is decent and the complex is well maintained.  The highlight is what they call the "backyard" which includes a. Ice pool, hot tub, dog park, fire pits, basketball courts, etc... the prices are not cheap, but I guess you get what you pay for!  It's not for everyone but I would definitely check them out.

Terrible service. don't bother making an appointment because every time I have come for a test, I have waited over an hour each time. It's not even because there is a line or anything. Rather than testing people one by one at they come. They wait for a line to build and then in a large group test everyone. So disorganized and expect to wait over an hour last appointment.
Wonderful place to get shop through for different stores try different foods. Korean hotdogs!

I went to nicks on Woodhaven and felt extremely unwanted from the start. The workers there are racist and stand around on their cell phones when they should be attending their tables. I work in the restaurant business and the owner should be absolutely embarrassed by the business he is running. My family and I waited for a good 15 minutes before we were greeted and i counted how many times the servers walked by us without greeting us. I don't know if they have sections here or if everything is up for grabs but this place is like a damn playground and should be more organized because that's how you keep a business running by staying organized. I'm rating this place a 1 star because zero stars is not an option.

This is a great place for Central American street food, which is hard to find in center city. I got the loroco pupusa and the salted caramel churro with soft serve. The pupusa was good, although it could have had a bit more flavor. I would give it a 3/5. However, the churro was amazing. It was very light and crispy and paired well with the soft serve, which wasn't heavy either. This was definitely a 5/5, and I would come back for this. I would suggest sharing one, as I wasn't able to finish it. Also, the prices are pretty good considering the large portion sizes.

Outstanding. This place is an absolute gem!  Very clean and open space with just the right light and cheer.  The staff were all so adorably friendly and helpful a d I got the absolute best almond croissant with chocolate. I arrived as the opened and they were still just a touch warm.  Perfection.  Lovely selection of tea. Must stop in.
Great spot for Italian that saves us the drive down to South Philly. The fresh mozzarella, veal parm, and boss pasta were all very good.
Large outdoor seating area tucked away from the street and delicious, inexpensive food. The eggs and French toast are especially good.

This place did an excellent job. The shape is perfect and color flawless. I got an acrylic gel refill with a matte finish no shortening of nails. Only reason I give 4 stars is because it was $55 without tip.

My girlfriends and I came out tonight to get a quick bite. I ordered calamari and salmon. Both were dry!. The calamari was fried too hard and the salmon was just a dried-up piece of fish. They took the calamari off of my bill but as the waitress said in her sassy tone the manager already took off the calamari he's not going to take off the salmon! I should have told him to come out and see for himself, but I'm just going to chalk this one up as an $18 loss! My girlfriends enjoyed their food - habanero wings, honey BBQ wings, lobster bisque and fajitas. If we decide to go here again I won't make the mistake of ordering the calamari nor the salmon.

Almost everything we have ordered tasted good (and authentic of course).
Chinese BBQ is a type of street food. Recently, a lot of the BBQ opened up restaurants with enhanced menu. Although I am satisfied with the quality of the food, I found this place to be quite over-priced. (Well the restaurant came from NYC and maybe that's why?)
I wouldn't recommend this place to people who are expecting to get American/Australian style BBQ. This is not it. You will find the portion smaller than your expectation and cost too high. 
The two of us spent $100 here. We can almost go to a steakhouse.
However, if you understand the concept of a Chinese BBQ or are into trying new things, you should give it a go!

Apparently this is their new location and it's a great location. I do not know what the old location is like. There is plenty of parking. They do need a sign visible from the street. We're weren't sure if this was right place from the street. 

It was a very cute store with a vintage vibe. There is a small fiber section with yarn and fabric. Don't expect to find anything in particular. I would not count this location as a "fabric" place. There are a few art supplies. As with any thrift store, you will have an ever-changing inventory. 

Staff was friendly and helpful.

Pretty cool craft beer bar. There are 3 floors. The first is long and narrow. A bar that seats about 20 on the left, and booths that seat 4 each on the right. There's an additional table in the front by the window. The 2nd floor is a dining area with a small bar. The 3rd floor has pool and darts. 

At the bartender's recommendation, my first beer was the Cloudy and Cumbersome hazy IPA. Very good. My 2nd was the Head Hunter IPA. Another great choice. My 3rd was the Freshies pale ale. Loved all 3. 

The music played was classic rock from the 70s. The Who, Heart, Zeppelin, The Stones, etc. 

Cool atmosphere, cool music, good beer, and a friendly staff. Check it out if you're in the area.

Decided to give Winnie's in Manuyunk a try after hearing some positive feedback on this place for brunch!

This is the first brunch place that gives you a variety basket of bread (raisin bread, corn bread, wheat bread, etc) with jam and butter. The jam was good but a bit too sweet for me. It was also a big jar of jam; which I assume is the same jar used for other tables as well. To me, sharing the same jar is not very sanitary...

My husband ordered the Huevos Rancheros which was surprisingly very good. There is no meat in this dish. I ordered the Crab Cake Bennie because I love trying Crab Cake everywhere I go. Although the Crab Cake wasn't bad, they skimped out on the portion of the crab cake, the crab cake was so thin, it was barely noticeable, which was a bit disappointing for a $16 brunch dish. Overall, the taste and quality was pretty average. 

I also ordered hot tea, which came in a tea pot with one tea bag for $4 - which I thought was a bit pricey for the tea bag.

Definition: (noun) the spot you're hoping is your neighborhood bar.

Obviously the bartenders are super friendly. It gets better. The bartender will buy your drink if you're drinking something less exciting.

They take a great time finding out your tastes and their is always a pro sport going on. My favorite aspect is that my bartender suggested a drink similar to what I was already drinking #homerun

Been to this location twice. Two horrible experiences with rude workers. The fact that their prices are criminal and their ice cream is PACKED with unhealthy ingredients is just the tip of the iceberg. Would go 0 stars if possible!

No consistency. My first cheesesteak in Philly...what a shame! 
I ordered 2 cheesesteaks with wiz and onions. Onions were raw and crunchy. My cheesesteak had almost no wiz on it and my bf's was loaded. 
Meat was well seasoned, but that was it. I should've gone to pats or ginos... oh well; live and learn...

I had the best meal of my life here last week. We ordered the cheddar biscuits to start which were delicious. For the entrees we had the hangar steak, the pork belly and the ravioli. The pork belly was truly the best thing I've ever eaten. It melted in my mouth and had a sweet sauce on the side. It was served with a peach salad on the side that paired so well with the dish. The hangar steak and ravioli were also phenomenal. We got a side of roasted beets to share which were great. The cocktails were also amazing.
Ravi and Connor were extremely helpful in finding me a plan! Looking forward to getting in the gym they made this a very easy choice for me.

Surprisingly roomy restaurant that is lacking in Vegetarian and Vegan options. It was my first time trying Vietnamese cuisine and the 2 vegetarian-friendly dishes they have were very good. Would definitely try again and hopefully they are more accommodating in the future.
The food was fresh and tasteful only problem is the wait time to reCieve the food from point of order otherwise that this the perfect place to get authentic fresh food from

Went there with lady friend, they gave us a hour and a half time limit , we sat for about one hour and 45 minutes , then one of the male host came over and embarrass us asking us to leave due to time limit. We paid our bill and sat across the park on lawn chairs for an addition 3 hours . Went back across street into park to order to go drinks and notice many of the tables had the same people seated there so I proceeded to ask the same gentleman why were we rushed to leave but the same people that were there for probable 2 or 3 hours after we left we're there. And he couldn't give me an explanation. This did not sit well with us. And we're considering taking action.

El Vez is a great spot in the heart of Center City Philadelphia. As the name suggests, the theme and cuisine are Mexican. 

My companion and I stopped in on a recent Philiy visit on a suprisingly busy Friday afternoon. We enjoyed the El Vez guacamole, which was delightful and also included a small serving of salsa. My companion also enjoyed a margarita while I stuck to beer. 

Attention foodies:  El Vez is NOT cutting-edge or daring cuisine. Why am I giving five stars?  Very simply:  El Vez, like the other Stephen Starr restaurants, features great atmosphere and service. We we seated at the bar and the staff training and great attitude were obvious. The two bartenders--and equally attentive barback--handled a large full bar and plenty of table customers with no noticeable hiccups.  Elsewhere, the servers and manager were friendly, enthusiastic, and attentive throughout the restaurant. It was a great sight to see in these COVID-challenged times for so many restaurants.

I recently came here for one of my friends 21st birthday. We made a reservation as we came with 12 people and they split us into two tables. Upon arriving, we had to wait for around 20 minutes to get seated despite the reservation we made. The overall aroma of this restaurant was really nice and very upbeat.

When browsing through the menu, it was fairly hard to navigate through it. Simple dishes like their pastas and even some of their entrees were hard to understand. Since it was hard to browse through, I ended up getting a basic Chicken Panini. My experience with this meal was not the best. The panini consisted of mostly spinach and lacked flavor. It was very dry and not the best meal. I also ended up trying the avocado toast which was also not the best. The avocado tasted like they just put the avocado on the bread without anything else and served it. So my experience with food was not the best.

Additionally, the prices for everything on the menu were pretty expensive. Therefore, I did not feel as if the meals I ate were worth the money paid. In terms of the alcoholic beverages, they have an option for bottomless mimosas. My friend ended up getting that and said that it was filled with a lot more orange juice than champagne. They also stated that the orange juice was filled with pulp which is something a lot of people do not like.

On the other hand, the server we had was great. She was very patient and attentive to us. She also made sure everyone was enjoying their experience and that there were no problems. However, one of the managers was a little pushy as she was trying to get us to leave after around an hour and a half. 

Overall, this is not a place I would recommend highly. If you would like to try it by all means do. I would just not go back there.

i have had two cleanings so far and cannot speak highly enough of Life Maid Easy. Every one of the cleaners has been wonderful, Rachel, Jessica, Sara, and Jaelyn were all terrific and friendly. I especially loved the deep clean as I had just moved into my home and some extra care was needed. My house looks so great, just in time for the holidays! What could be better?

Good tomato pie but the customer service is the only thing deterring me from coming back. I called today, 12/3/21 at about 3:15pm and the woman that answered the phone was very rude and unwelcoming. I felt rushed when she answered the phone, I was multitasking at the bank at the time and didn't want to be rude to either person helping me but she didn't have to be that offputting. I hope that this doesn't continue, I really like this place

We were looking at menus in Northern Liberties and this place seemed like exactly the gastropubby food we like. We ordered the Eggplant fries, honey chicken sandwich, mushroom soup, and buffalo cauliflower. The eggplant fries were so different and delicious and such a good idea to change it up from potatoes. They tasted delicious with the aioli that it came with. We saw other people ordering the chicken sandwich and decided to give it shot and it turned out delicious!! Will definitely come back here again. The inside of the bar also has a cool and different vibe.
Gorgeous fitness center w friendly staff. It's very clean with plenty of parking. I came here to take a Zumba class and it was awesome!!

Doma is the best sushi in Philly! Salmon avocado rolls are always incredible. We have moved out of the area but still make the trip to Doma for our sushi. Also the ginger salad dressing is devine! Friendly staff, affordable... We are looking forward to dining indoor again when its safe!

Giving a single star is overrated! They are I'll equipped to handle more than 10 people at a time and still you end up standing 30-60 minutes to donate! They NEVER have one person on intake and that one person is as SLOW!  They have all donors standing long long lines for hours. The max number of workers sticking for the donation I've ever seen is 3. People and workers do not wear masks properly and some of those who are donating are not wearing masks at all and coughing! Seriously the worst place to donate!

Delicious as hip city veg always is! As of October 2020, this location does not have  indoor or outdoor dining but it is a few minute walk from rittenhouse square which has plenty of bench space. I would give it 5 stars but it's too expensive for the amount of food you get.
I continue to enjoy their lattes and pastries! Plus, the ordering process is easy despite COVID restrictions.

Overall this was a solid enough experience.  Our server was very kind and warm but quickly pointed out she was new and had not tried many of the dishes....so could only recommend what was popular.  We wanted a slow pace experience, so did not mind long waits (ex: the check sat on the table for 10 minutes waiting to be run).   The pasta portions were large and flavorful, and definitely the high point of the meal.  I was not a huge fan of the crudo, given I prefer my crudo served cold and without skin, and this was served room temperature with the skin still on, but perhaps others enjoy this preparation? Another plus is when we asked for a bottle of wine, the wine director recommended a bottle which was on the low end of the range we stated and very much met the characteristics we described.   I would go back at some point to try the pizza, but definitely not running back.
Got Bambu's favorite (#10) and it was pretty good. The Pandan Jelly is very chewy, and nice kind of like mochi.

nice outside seating. classic greek offerings including the best gyros in town. for a light lunch try the Greek Salad with your choice of protein. the lamb shank with and artichokes is my favorite dinner entrée.

I'm a very open minded person with quite low standards for food especially while drunk as fuck. However, I feel that I paid a high rate for food that really didn't satisfy my cravings. I paid extra for ranch that I didn't receive. Devastating to say the least. I understand that people forget but NO RANCH that's fuckin wacky. Food was mid I kinda enjoyed my sandwich but that was probably just the fireball talking. All in all, will probably return whilst drunk again because I have dirt low standards but wouldn't recommend to mentally stable individuals.

I am absolutely addicted to the bowls!  Have tried, and love, both the Sriracha chicken bowl and the flank steak bowl. Delicious! The order is always packed carefully, and arrives at lightning speed. They always seem to be their estimated delivery time. The delivery people have been terrific as well... Safe and friendly. Highly recommended

A friend and I stopped by Monk's on a Saturday around 5 pm for dinner. We were seated right away. The space itself is pretty small, so I was pleasantly surprised that we were seated so quickly on a busy night.

From looking around at what everyone else had ordered, we could tell that the mussels are a popular menu item. Sadly, we were craving burgers and fries. I ordered mine with Cheddar and Bacon and my friend got hers with Mushrooms and Swiss. Both burgers were cooked as requested. The fries were a highlight for sure. Perfectly crisp and well seasoned. They came with some kind of aoili that was tangy and delicious on both the fries and my burger. We washed our burgers down with some Allagash White beers from the tap. 

The overall menu selection for beers was really impressive. The service was very attentive and we were in and out in about an hour. 

FYI - they have signs around the restaurant advertising a 90 minute table limit. This has been pretty common since the pandemic, so we understood but we did not realize when we had arrived that this was a policy.
Great brunch! The bottomless mimosas were fun, the decor is great and I was actually impressed with the food! Definitely a little pricey, but for brunch and the atmosphere, totally worth it!

They food and service here was great. We were sat at a not so pleasant location but when another table opened up we were automatically offered that spot without asking. I suppose they just knew. The fried chapter was great as was the chicken sandwich. Going again!

I was pretty disappointed with this place. I was looking forward to it for quite some time too. I first walked in and was having a private conversation and one of the workers thought it'd be best so share his personal opinion. When it came to ordering, he also overheard our conversation and began to defend items on the menu. Found it to be classless and unprofessional. Besides this occurrence, I found the ice cream to be extremely average. I ordered a small strawberry shortcake and it did not taste as such.
